decisions: Record Binance's 90% aggregate replenishment as a company claim reported by Reuters, not as an independently audited reserve result.
Record XRP's inclusion in the ten-token minimum 1:1 coverage set, while keeping the full proof and asset-level liability reconciliation pending.
Do not infer XRP-specific purchases, XRP-specific replenishment quantities or spot demand from the aggregate 90% figure.
Store Liqwall and Binance price observations as separate provider-specific snapshots with their own data timestamps.
Do not compare rolling 24-hour liquidations with partial UTC calendar-day totals.
Do not use Binance account long-share as notional exposure or the page's broad Fear & Greed value as XRP-specific sentiment.
Keep all new observations out of directional prediction features until source, timestamp and contract-universe reconciliation is complete.
required_verification: Full Binance post-incident PoR with asset-level XRP reserve and liability values.
Reserve-address crosswalk for the five Binance incident XRPL source wallets.
Cross-provider contract-level XRP open-interest and funding reconciliation.
Walk-forward, leakage-safe benchmark and probability calibration before issuing forecasts.
